Ba-barakat hai woh zaat jis ke haathon mein saara mulk hai aur woh har shai par qaadir o mukhtaar hai
Us ne maut o hayaat ko is liye paida kiya hai taake tumhaari aazmaaish kare ke tum mein husn-e-amal ke etibaar se sab se behtar kaun hai, aur woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur bakhshne waala bhi hai
Usi ne saat aasmaan teh-ba-teh paida kiye hain aur tum Rehmaan ki khilqat mein kisi tarah ka farq na dekhoge. Phir dobaara nigaah utha kar dekho, kahin koi shigaaf nazar aata hai
Is ke baad baar baar nigaah daalo, dekho nigaah thak kar palat aaegi lekin koi aib nazar na aaega
Hum ne aasmaan-e-duniya ko chiraaghon se muzayyan kiya hai aur unhein shayaateen ko sangsaar karne ka zariya bana diya hai, aur un ke liye Jahannam ka azaab alag muhayya kar rakha hai
Aur jin logon ne apne Parwardigar ka inkaar kiya hai un ke liye Jahannam ka azaab hai aur wahi badtareen anjaam hai
Jab bhi woh us mein daale jaayenge us ki cheekh sunenge aur woh josh maar raha hoga
Balke qareeb hoga ke josh ki shiddat se phat pade. Jab bhi us mein kisi giroh ko daala jaaega to us ke daaroghe un se poochhenge ke kya tumhaare paas koi daraane waala nahin aaya tha
To woh kahenge ke aaya to tha lekin hum ne use jhutla diya aur ye keh diya ke Allah ne kuchh bhi naazil nahin kiya hai, tum log khud bahut badi gumraahi mein mubtala ho
Aur phir kahenge ke agar hum baat sun lete aur samajhte hote to aaj Jahannam waalon mein na hote
To unhon ne khud apne gunaah ka iqraar kar liya, to ab Jahannam waalon ke liye to rehmat-e-Khuda se doori hi doori hai
Be-shak jo log baghair dekhe apne Parwardigar ka khauf rakhte hain un ke liye maghfirat aur ajr-e-azeem hai
Aur tum log apni baaton ko aahista kaho ya buland aawaaz se, Khuda to seenon ke raazon ko bhi jaanta hai
Aur kya paida karne waala nahin jaanta hai jab ke woh lateef bhi hai aur khabeer bhi hai
Usi ne tumhaare liye zameen ko narm bana diya hai ke us ke atraaf mein chalo aur rizq-e-Khuda talaash karo, phir usi ki taraf qabron se uth kar jaana hai
Kya tum aasmaan mein hukoomat karne waale ki taraf se mutmain ho gaye ke woh tum ko zameen mein dhansa de aur woh tumhein gardish hi deti rahe
Ya tum us ki taraf se is baat se mehfooz ho gaye ke woh tumhaare oopar pattharon ki baarish kar de, phir tumhein bahut jald maaloom ho jaaega ke mera daraana kaisa hota hai
Aur un se pehle waalon ne bhi takzeeb ki hai, to dekho ke un ka anjaam kitna bhayaanak hua hai

Kya in logon ne apne oopar un parindon ko nahin dekha hai jo par phaila dete hain aur samet lete hain, ke unhein is fiza mein Allah ke ilaawa koi nahin sambhaal sakta, ke wahi har shai ki nigraani karne waala hai
Kya ye jo tumhaari fauj bana hua hai Khuda ke muqaable mein tumhaari madad kar sakta hai? Be-shak kuffaar sirf dhoke mein pade hue hain
Ya ye tum ko rozi de sakta hai agar Khuda apni rozi ko rok le? Haqeeqat ye hai ke ye log naafarmaani aur nafrat mein gharq ho gaye hain
Kya woh shakhs jo munh ke bal chalta hai woh zyaada hidaayat-yaafta hai ya jo seedhe seedhe Siraat-e-Mustaqeem par chal raha hai
Aap keh deejiye ke Khuda hi ne tumhein paida kiya hai aur usi ne tumhaare liye kaan, aankh aur dil qaraar diye hain, magar tum bahut kam shukriya ada karne waale ho
Keh deejiye ke wahi woh hai jis ne zameen mein tumhein phaila diya hai aur usi ki taraf tumhein jama kar ke le jaaya jaaega
Aur ye log kehte hain ke agar tum log sachche ho to ye waada kab poora hoga
Aap keh deejiye ke ilm Allah ke paas hai aur main to sirf waazeh taur par daraane waala hoon
Phir jab us Qiyaamat ke azaab ko qareeb dekhenge to kaafiron ke chehre bigad jaayenge aur un se kaha jaaega ke yahi woh azaab hai jis ke tum khwaastgaar the
Aap keh deejiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai ke Khuda mujhe aur mere saathiyon ko halaak kar de ya hum par rahm kare, to in kaafiron ka dardnaak azaab se bachaane waala kaun hai
Keh deejiye ke wahi Khuda-e-Rehmaan hai jis par hum imaan laaye hain aur usi par hamaara bharosa hai, phir anqareeb tumhein maaloom ho jaaega ke khuli hui gumraahi mein kaun hai
Keh deejiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai agar tumhaara saara paani zameen ke andar jazb ho jaaye to tumhaare liye chashme ka paani baha kar kaun laaega
